title: Least tensor supports stabilize along a directed colimit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $H$ an $R$-module, $I$ a small nonempty directed partially ordered set, and $(N_k,\mu_{k\ell})_{k\in I}$ a directed system of $R$-modules with colimit $(N,(\mu_k))$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For any $R$-module $L$, say that a submodule $G\subseteq H$ supports $y\in H\otimes_R L$ when $y$ belongs to the image of the inclusion-induced map $G\otimes_R L\to H\otimes_R L$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]; a least support is a supporting submodule contained in every supporting submodule. Fix $i\in I$ and $x_i\in H\otimes_R N_i$, write $x_k=(1_H\otimes\mu_{ik})(x_i)$ for $k\ge i$, and $x=(1_H\otimes\mu_i)(x_i)\in H\otimes_R N$. Suppose $x$ has a least support $Q\subseteq H$ and, for every $k\ge i$, $x_k$ has a least support $C_k\subseteq H$. Then $Q\subseteq C_k$ for every $k\ge i$ and $C_\ell\subseteq C_k$ whenever $\ell\ge k\ge i$. There exist $j\ge i$ and $t\in Q\otimes_R N_j$ whose image in $H\otimes_R N_j$ is $x_j$, and $C_k=Q$ for every $k\ge j$. No injectivity of transition maps, finite generation of $Q$, or countability of $I$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 059S (lemma-flat-ML-criterion), proof: commutative square and final paragraph beginning "Since the $Q_j$ are decreasing", stated for tensors with given least supports.

proof.text: For $G\subseteq H$ write $a_{G,L}:G\otimes_RL\to H\otimes_RL$ for the inclusion-induced map. For every linear $f:L\to L'$, $(1_H\otimes f)a_{G,L}=a_{G,L'}(1_G\otimes f)$: both sides send $g\otimes n$ to $g\otimes f(n)$, and pure tensors generate. Thus a support of a tensor also supports its image. Since $C_k$ supports $x_k$, it supports $x$ and every $x_\ell$ with $\ell\ge k$. Leastness gives $Q\subseteq C_k$ and $C_\ell\subseteq C_k$ for all $\ell\ge k\ge i$.

source.place: Tag 059S (lemma-flat-ML-criterion), proof, commutative square and final paragraph; tensor-colimit comparison from Tag 00DD (lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits), and representatives/eventual equality from Tags 00D6 (lemma-directed-colimit) and 00D7 (lemma-zero-directed-limit).

proof.text: For any $R$-module $A$, the tensor-colimit theorem applied with fixed factor $A$ makes $N\otimes_RA$ a colimit of $N_s\otimes_RA$. The maps $n\otimes a\mapsto a\otimes n$ and $a\otimes n\mapsto n\otimes a$ are inverse by the tensor universal property and generation by pure tensors; they commute with transition maps on pure tensors. Hence $A\otimes_RN$, with legs $1_A\otimes\mu_s$, is a colimit of $A\otimes_RN_s$. As $Q$ supports $x$, choose $u\in Q\otimes_RN$ with $a_{Q,N}(u)=x$. The elementwise colimit theorem, for $A=Q$, gives $h\in I$ and $v\in Q\otimes_RN_h$ mapping to $u$.

source.place: Tag 059S (lemma-flat-ML-criterion), proof, commutative square and final paragraph; tensor-colimit comparison from Tag 00DD (lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits), and representatives/eventual equality from Tags 00D6 (lemma-directed-colimit) and 00D7 (lemma-zero-directed-limit).

proof.text: The elements $a_{Q,N_h}(v)\in H\otimes_RN_h$ and $x_i\in H\otimes_RN_i$ have the same image $x$ in $H\otimes_RN$, by step 1 and the choice of $v$. Apply the equality clause of the elementwise colimit theorem to the tensor colimit of step 2 with $A=H$. It gives a common stage $j\ge h,i$ where their images agree. Put $t=(1_Q\otimes\mu_{hj})(v)$. The square in step 1 gives $a_{Q,N_j}(t)=(1_H\otimes\mu_{hj})a_{Q,N_h}(v)=(1_H\otimes\mu_{ij})(x_i)=x_j$.

source.place: Tag 059S (lemma-flat-ML-criterion), proof, commutative square and final paragraph; tensor-colimit comparison from Tag 00DD (lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits), and representatives/eventual equality from Tags 00D6 (lemma-directed-colimit) and 00D7 (lemma-zero-directed-limit).

proof.text: The tensor $t$ shows that $Q$ supports $x_j$, so leastness gives $C_j\subseteq Q$. Step 1 gives $Q\subseteq C_j$, hence $C_j=Q$. For every $k\ge j$, again by step 1, $Q\subseteq C_k\subseteq C_j=Q$, and therefore $C_k=Q$. This proves the witness and all stabilization assertions.
